mechanism.cuda_graph_behavior: Enabled --use_cuda_graph captures a gather-only graph and an attention-only graph for stream-only layers; graph replay on side stream was proven in ENV_AUDIT.raw.txt and exercised by telemetry.
mechanism.default_behavior: Unset/empty/0 keeps inline stream-only gather and fused stream-only CUDA graph capture.
mechanism.enabled_behavior: For stream-only layers, launch gather_copy_cluster_and_concat_fuse after top-k on a per-device side stream, overlap with estimation-zone graph/work, and current-stream wait_event before weighted_flash_decoding reads the execution buffer.
